content.short: Abstract is a consumer-focused Layer 2 blockchain built on Ethereum using the ZK stack for high speed and low costs.
content.description: Abstract is an Ethereum Layer 2 blockchain developed by Igloo Inc., the parent company of the Pudgy Penguins NFT project. Built using the zkSync ZK stack and EigenDA, it is specifically optimized for consumer-facing applications such as gaming, social networks, and entertainment. The network features the Abstract Global Wallet (AGW), which simplifies the user experience through passkeys and social logins. By implementing panoramic governance and focus on cultural alignment, Abstract aims to onboard the next generation of users into the decentralized economy with a seamless and intuitive interface.
content.meta: Abstract is a ZK-powered Layer 2 blockchain designed for consumer crypto and gaming. Discover Abstract and other Blockchains on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
